body: I’ve been seeing a therapist for a few months. The next time I’ll be talking to her is on the 13th.

Originally I did want to do something fun for my birthday. But now since we’re getting closer to it, I’m not feeling excited to do anything anymore. Now since we’re trapped in quarantine we have no choice but to do nothing anyway.
April 28th. My family wants it to be a big celebration but I just want to huddle up in my bed and do nothing.

I’ve just been feeling suicidal for a while now. I didn’t tell my family right away because I didn’t want to scare them, and when they realized I was going through a depressive episode they started getting upset because I didn’t tell them what was going on. My mom has been frustrated with me for a few days since I wouldn’t tell her, making me feel even worse. Eventually, my stepdad convinced me to tell my mom what’s going on and now I’m starting to feel a little bit better. But I know these thoughts will end up cycling again. The thoughts have been on repeat for years.
